channels.r: antialiased land coverage anchored to binary occupancy
channels.b: continuous 14px bidirectional shore-distance falloff; runtime coast materials choose the visible contact width
channels.a: authored land luminance continued beneath the exterior shelf

policy: Every shoreline uses this same deterministic derivation.
Terrain relief supplies the packed underwater substrate value.
The 4x field resamples continuous distances and reconstructs coverage.
The runtime derives shore normals from the shelf gradient.
Sparse authored crash accents belong to actors-effects in Phase 7.
